difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-dualizing, for a morphism f : X -> Y of finite type schemes over S and dualizing complexes omega_X and omega_Y normalised relative to omega_S, the lemma asserts that omega_X is also normalised relative to omega_Y (statement lines 5486-5523). The proof is explicitly bookkeeping: choose a finite affine open covering V : Y = union V_j, and for each j a finite affine open covering f^{-1}(V_j) = union U_{ji}, giving the covering U of X; the schemes involved are separated over S, so the upper shriek functors exist for q_j : V_j -> S, p_{ji} : U_{ji} -> S, f_{ji} : U_{ji} -> V_j and f'_{ji} : U_{ji} -> Y (proof lines 5525-5536). Taking (L, beta_j) normalised relative to V and (K, gamma_{ji}) normalised relative to U, with L = omega_Y and K = omega_X, the proof defines alpha_{ji} as the composite K|_{U_{ji}} -> p_{ji}^!omega_S = f_{ji}^!q_j^!omega_S -> f_{ji}^!(L|_{V_j}) = (f'_{ji})^!(L) and states that the compatibility of alpha on overlaps is formal, omitting the details (proof lines 5538-5552). Recognising that the normalisation is bookkeeping against two chosen coverings and that the only content is the comparison along the shriek functors of the affine pieces is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2; the omitted formal compatibility is recorded verbatim in the notes.
